name: Fourier PlenOctree
definition: A method designed for human silhouette rendering using Shape-From-Silhouette, storing colors and densities on a coarse PlenOctree and using a Fourier Transform MLP.
summary: Fourier PlenOctree is a 4D scene representation that enables real-time dynamic rendering by storing Fourier coefficients for density and color within a unified octree structure.
